title: COP31: UN Climate summit runs into second day of overtime
summary: After weeks of negotiations, countries remain divided on how to fight global warming. Nations are now eyeing a third and final draft text. DW has more.
byline: Dmytro Hubenko, Patrick Große, Mark Hallam, Karl Sexton, Nik Martin

image.caption: Activists protested the failure of COP31 after a second draft text dropped all mention of fossil fuels Image: Umit Bektas/REUTERS

blocks.text: As COP31 extends into a second day of overtime, we are pausing our coverage.
In the early hours of Sunday, COP31 President and Turkish Environment Minister Murat Kurum informed delegates at a plenary that a third and "final" text would be sent to them for review.
He added that negotiators would have until 6:00 am (0400 GMT) "to come to us with agreement on the text" and that a closing plenary would then be convened at 9:00 am local time.
Stay tuned for more news in the coming hours.
